description: This source file contains functions for managing plugin metadata, including copying plugin assets, rewriting package extensions and paths, collecting top-level public entries, and handling bundled plugin distribution for an OpenClaw-related project. It supports features like deterministic path resolution, retry logic on copy errors, and plugin metadata generation.

methods.name: copyBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Main function to copy plugin metadata and assets from source to distribution directories, handling plugin manifests and skills.

methods.name: rewritePackageExtensions
methods.description: Rewrites a list of extension entries, normalizing paths to use .js extension.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level JS/TS files from a plugin directory, excluding test or spec files.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines whether a package without a manifest is a supported runtime support package based on its name and public surface entries.

methods.name: resolveDeclaredSkillSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path for a declared skill, considering plugin directory and repo root.

methods.name: resolveBundledSkillTarget
methods.description: Resolves the output path for a bundled skill, especially handling node_modules resolution.
